children.game_version: A circle game focusing on matching the leader's rhythm.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the rhythmic handclapping and upper body undulations while seated in a circle.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the dance in a circle with support from a chair or partner.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms are often linked or held close to neighbors; hands are used for clapping.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circle, semicircle, or two facing lines.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Trembling and undulating movements that ripple through the group.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, standing shoulder to shoulder in a compact block.

signature_moves.description: A wave-like motion that moves through the line of dancers, resembling wind over wheat.
signature_moves.name: Collective Undulation

music_profile.musical_form: Call and response or collective chanting.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic pulse provided by the bendir frame drum and handclapping.
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by the steady, resonant beat of the bendir frame drum, punctuated by the rhythmic clapping of the dancers and the communal singing of traditional Berber chants.

basic_steps: Stand shoulder to shoulder with partners.
Perform trembling movements through the torso.
Create large, undulating waves with the arms and body.
teaching.formation: Circle, semicircle, or two facing lines.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner: Focus on maintaining the shoulder-to-shoulder connection and following the group rhythm.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic pulse provided by the bendir drum and handclapping.
